en: Rectangular card printed in German, formatted like an official notice or postal card. The heading line at the top right reads "Riga, Datum d. Poststempels". The body text refers to the Monument Administration at the Ministry of Education of Latvia sending out a publication. A typed insertion reads "E. Brastinsch Lettlands Burgberge Livland". There are dotted lines for filling in information and a closing line "Denkmälerverwaltung" at the bottom right.
